pvpui.opt.split_meeting: Merge after Act 3 and fight PvP
pvpui.opt.split_meeting_fast_test: Merge test: first win is enough
pvpui.desc.max_cards_per_turn: Playing this many cards ends your turn automatically (the vanilla Time Eater caps at 12).
pvpui.desc.extra_turn_limit: How many consecutive extra turns (Pael's Eye style) the same player may receive.
pvpui.desc.second_energy: The second player gets this much extra energy on their first turn.
yj.page.title: YouJin Spire
yj.opt.first_turn_guard: Turn guard: no damage for the first N turns
yj.desc.hp_multiplier: Multiplier applied to everyone's max HP in the PvP fight (default 3x).
yj.desc.cards_per_turn: Max cards each player may play per turn; "Unlimited" = vanilla. Range 10-30.
pvpui.desc.hp_multiplier: Multiplier on both players' max HP (same value as speed mode). There is no round limit any more, so raise this for a longer duel. ⚠ Both ends must match.
pvpui.desc.max_same_card_per_turn: After this many plays, that specific card cannot be played again this turn. Counts per card instance, not per card name.
yj.desc.party_mode: Pick exactly one: Greedy (kill-steal gold/relics, Laziness/Deep Sleep campfire, three custom events) | Shared (one HP pool, wallet and energy for the team) | Quest (three tasks per player per act, paid out at the act boss) | Split (each player runs their own single-player run from the same seed, then merges for PvP; picking it switches PvP style to turn-based) | Hunt (map votes can split into separate branches inside one run). Off = vanilla.
yj.desc.pvp_style: Pick exactly one: Speed = everyone plays cards in the same turn and ends it together, whoever is faster resolves first (Act 5 victory room becomes The Architect's Provocation); Turn-based = strict alternating turns with no monsters (an extra "PVP Duel" act after Act 3, entered through the Duel Invitation event). Neither does anything in single-player or three-player runs. ⚠ Both ends must pick the same.
yj.desc.mole: Each act, one random player becomes the mole: no tasks of their own, they steal other players' tasks for double rewards. In single player it's automatically Off.
yj.desc.first_turn_guard: Until every player has finished turn N, all hp loss is clamped to 0 (block is still consumed normally). 0 = no guard at all.
